C0570.title: POS Terminal Voucher Cash-Out Scheme Involving 6.55 Million Yuan Leads to 102 Arrests
C0570.summary: On June 13, 2023, regulators strengthened risk controls targeting POS terminal voucher cash-outs and dismantled a case involving 6.55 million yuan in illegally redeemed consumer vouchers, resulting in the arrest of 102 suspects.
